0.heading: Overview
refs: 2Th 3:1 , Paul craves their prayers for himself
2Th 3:3 , testifies what confidence he has in them
2Th 3:5 , makes request to God in their behalf
2Th 3:6 , gives them divers precepts, especially to shun idleness, and ill company
2Th 3:16 , and then concludes with prayer and salutation.
